user.title: SmartThings Sub A/C
user.description:
Adds sub components of a SmartThings device (e.g. the wall-mounted unit of a 2-in-1 air conditioner) as climate entities.

Authentication is reused from the existing SmartThings integration, so there is nothing to enter.

abort.smartthings_not_configured: Set up the SmartThings integration first.
